name: InterContinental Edinburgh The George
positioning: Historic hotel on George Street in Edinburgh's New Town, spread across five original Georgian townhouses
best_for: Travelers who want a historic Georgian base in Edinburgh's New Town
Guests who want a suite with Club InterContinental access

facts.text: The hotel is spread across five original Georgian townhouses.
The hotel's Georgian townhouses are in Edinburgh's New Town.
The hotel is a historic hotel on George Street in Edinburgh.
The rooms use rich tweeds, warm woods and luxurious linens.
The suites are situated within the original 18th-century townhouses.
The Ferrier Suite is in the original townhouse at 25 George Street, once home to the Ferrier family in the late 1700s.
One Bedroom Suites have separate living areas.
Every room includes Byredo luxury toiletries, bathrobes and slippers.
Suite guests receive a complimentary minibar, fresh flowers and a Nespresso machine.
The Printing Press Bar & Kitchen occupies the former home of the writer Susan Ferrier.
The Scottish National Portrait Gallery is a four-minute walk from the hotel.

highlights.text: The Somerville Suite is named after Mary Somerville, the Edinburgh-born scientist for whom the word 'scientist' was coined.
The two-bedroom Somerville Suite has views over George Street, roll-top baths and walk-in showers.
The guest rooms take their colour palette from 19th-century Scottish landscape paintings.
The Printing Press menu includes very local Scottish dishes such as cullen skink and rumbledethumps.

considerations.text: Club InterContinental lounge access is included with suites.
WhataHotel notes limited parking availability in the busy city centre.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning and prime location.
